_about: Every tuning number for the web game.

clearing._about: The starting clearing (tiles), centred in the forest. Small on purpose: the starter kit and the first few days of buying fill it, so Room to grow matters.

start._about: A new garden opens on a little grotto around the 2x2 pool at its centre: the pool's streams, debris along its edge (rocks, ferns, roots: they take up their tiles until cleared), and the opening's seed tin (Content/opening.json) on a free tile within tin.near of the pool.

garden._about: The garden. Plants (Content/plants.json) grow through stages (seed, sprout, bud, ready; a plant only flowers when it's ready to pick) over growHours on their own school's soil, timed from timestamps so time away counts. soil: growth speed on the plant's own soil (preferred), on plain soil (plain); on another school's soil it can't be planted at all. stages: the share of growth at which sprout and bud begin; ready (in bloom) at 1. Per plant (plants): growHours, yield (produce per harvest), seeds [packets always returned, chance of one more], sell (coins per produce). Every plant leaves its tile when it's harvested. Seed packets and their odds: packets. amendments: the Store's daily soil stock. sellByRarity: the price of anything else in the Bag that can be sold (foraged finds). startCoins: coins in a new garden. starterSet: what the opening's tin holds: Common seeds of the chosen school and of the runner-up, and a few amendments of each. morning: after minAwayHours of real time away a card sums up what's ready; at most one surprise per local day, with surpriseChance, chosen by weight among the kinds possible right now.

soil._wrong: A plant whose tile was overtaken by another school's soil keeps growing, at this speed.

levels._about: Soil matures one level each night it holds (tuning.tides), 1 to max. On a plant's own soil each level above 1 adds speedPerLevel to its speed, and from yieldAt it gives +1 produce. Higher levels look more strongly of their school.

amendments._about: Soil amendments are scarce: the Store stocks perDay school amendments each local day (one bag each, chosen from the garden seed and the day) at `price`; Garden loam (back to plain) is always there at plainPrice. Other sources: the opening's tin, and the soil patches Room to grow uncovers.

morning._kinds: selfSeed: a seedling next to a blooming plant. gift: a befriended visitor leaves its gift seeds in the Bag. rareColour: a ready plant with a colour variety turns out to be that variety (its harvest gives the variety's produce and seeds).

companions._about: Each plant has a few neighbour rules (Content/plants.json companions): when a named plant grows in one of its 8 neighbouring tiles (at any stage), a speed rule makes it grow speed times as fast and a yield rule adds `yield` produce to its harvest. Several speed rules don't stack beyond maxSpeed. A rule is discovered (and shown on the plant's Field Guide page) the first time it is active at a harvest.

decor._about: What decor does, by kind (Content/cosmetics.json kind; relic ornaments are kind ornament). beauty: added to the garden's beauty while placed. ground: drawn flat under everything (paths). holdsPlant: a plant can be planted on it (a raised bed), and gets `yield` extra produce. glow: lights up at dusk and night. Ornaments (Content/relics.json): plants of the relic's school within `radius` tiles (a 3x3) grow schoolSpeed times as fast.

beauty._about: Garden beauty, never shown as a number: variety x each distinct plant growing in the garden, blooming x each plant in bloom (ready), plus every placed decor's beauty (decor.kinds). It shows as a named tier with a leaf meter. The best tier ever reached opens Store items (plants' `beauty`, listings' 'Needs beauty tier') and never relocks.

varieties._about: Colour varieties (plants.json varieties: a hue, and leaves to recolour the greens too). Cross-pollination: harvesting a plant while a plant of the same family (the same kind counts) blooms in one of its 8 neighbours gives, with `chance`, one seed packet of one of its varieties (one not yet found first). Kept hidden from the player. A variety grows like its plant and breeds true; its produce sells for sellMult times as much and has its own Field Guide entry.

collections._about: Field Guide collections: harvest every plant of a school (its seed plants and its gift plant) once to complete it; the reward is that school's relic ornament (Content/relics.json) and `coins`.

orders._about: Daily orders at the Old Log (requests of kind 'order'): perDay of them each local day, picked (deterministically, from the garden seed and the day) from the orders whose produce comes from plants the player has already harvested.

packets._about: Seed packets are blind pulls: each school sells Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic and Legendary seeds. Planting one picks a plant from that school's seed plants (plants.json source 'seeds'): first a tier by the packet's `odds` (never a sure thing: every tier keeps a chance of every plant tier its odds list, and no tier is certain), then evenly among that school's plants of the tier (a tier with none steps down). The plant shows only as a seedling until it reaches its bud. Harvests return seeds of the plant's own school and tier (seeds per plant in plants), so rare plants give rare seeds (and epic ones epic seeds). Epic and Legendary plants are the catalogue's Very rare and Legendary finds; a school with no Legendary plant steps a Legendary pull down to Epic. `price` in the Store; `beauty`: the beauty tier that puts that tier of seeds on the shelf. Gift plants and colour varieties keep their own named packets.

forage._about: The foraging patch: a few plain finds turn up by chance on the clearing's outer ring, by the treeline. Every slotMinutes of game time (offline included, at most maxCatchUpSlots), each slot has `chance` of one find, up to `max` waiting at once. Which slot gets a find, the tile and the item are hashed from the garden seed and the slot, so it's deterministic. Tap to pick. Set enabled false to turn the patch off.

expansion._about: Room to grow (Store): each purchase clears the trees on one side the player chooses (top, bottom, left or right), sideTiles rows deep. The new ground isn't empty: each purchase uncovers a patch of wildSoilTiles tiles of one school's soil along the old edge (a different school each time, in an order shuffled by the garden seed) and, beside it, that school's wild feature. Features stay where they grew (they can't be moved or bought) and add their beauty to the garden. The foraging patch moves out with the treeline on its own.

spore.name: Mossy stone
spore.text: A stone furred with moss. The ground around it stays damp and dark.

glow.name: Glowing flowers
glow.text: Wild flowers that glow faintly after dark. The soil here shines a little too.

bloom.name: Wild flowers
bloom.text: A clump of flowers no one planted. Petals have fallen into the soil for years.

verdure.name: Old oak
verdure.text: An oak older than the clearing. Leaf mould lies thick beneath it.

shimmer.name: Crystal outcrop
shimmer.text: Crystals pushing up through the earth. The ground glitters around them.

spirit.name: Misty pine
spirit.text: A tall pine that keeps a little mist around its roots.

offerings._about: The Old Log board and Store (Resources/Content/requests.json, cosmetics.json from design/Undergrowth_Offerings.xlsx). Recolouring a placed decor prop costs recolorCost (0 = free).

visitors._about: Visitors (Content/visitors.json): forest animals that leave mementos, then move in. Every checkMinutes of game time (offline catch-up included, up to maxCatchUpDays) each visitor's interest rises by interest.gain while every plant it likes is in bloom (ready to pick), and falls by interest.decay when not. In its time window, once interest reaches visits.firstAt (its first memento) or visits.at[tier] (later visits), it visits unseen with chance visits.chance, at most visits.perDay a day, and leaves its next memento. On the visit after its last memento it moves in if every condition in its `stays` holds (soil patches it claims for itself: one soil tile, one resident), else it leaves a plainer hint (`restate`). A resident stays while its conditions hold and leaves at the first check where one doesn't, with a parting memento (`parting`). Moving in gives its gift seeds (gift.count) once, and residents leave the morning card's gift surprise. Perks (visitors.json perk): growth multiplies the speed of plants of its school on its patch; tideHold keeps its patch's soil through the tides. The Stump (tribute): an offering is taken at the next nightfall and works for tribute.hours: visitors of its school (and of a tier its own tier reaches: common items early visitors, uncommon settled too, rare all) gain interest tribute.mult[tier] times as fast, gain tribute.court of the normal rate even when their plants aren't blooming, and visit tribute.likedMult times as often if it's a plant they like. It never leaves a memento itself; when its time is up the Stump answers (lingered, moved or untouched). Deterministic from the garden, the visitor and the check's time.

naming._about: A garden left unnamed takes its name from its most common soil (Content/nameParts.json).

clock._about: Real local time of day: the four lighting states and the visitors' time windows (dawn, day, dusk, night).

canopy._about: Tree shadows from design/shadow_overlay_v2.webp (processed by tools/gen_canopy.py into img/canopy.png: alpha = sunlight, texelsPerPx image px per art px, drawn smooth at up to maxRes buffer px per art px). Layer 1 at full strength, layer 2 offset/scaled/flipped and added at secondAlpha so the flecks never repeat on a grid, and a large soft region layer that lifts the shade in some areas (clearings).

lighting._about: Per state; values blend smoothly across clock.transitionMinutes around each boundary. shade/light = canopy shade and sunlight-patch strength (light is drawn with canopy.lightBlend); glow = warm glow on the brightest centres; shafts = strength of the diagonal light beams; classic = the earlier look's values (Debug: Sunlight classic). ambient multiplies the whole scene.

softCorners._about: Soil tiles clip a corner where neither tile beside it has the same soil: the corner is rounded off with a circle of `radius` art pixels, fading out over the last `soft` pixels in `steps` alpha steps.

soilDetails._about: Small things growing on school soil (detail.<school>.a/b): each soil tile shows one with chance[level - 1], so older soil is busier. Hidden under plants, decor and debris.

water._about: The pool (a 2x2 block of water at the centre of a new clearing) and its streams. A new garden's streams take riverTiles water tiles (not counting the pool), in at least minStreams streams: either leaving the pool in different directions or forking, meandering at random (keepDirection: chance to carry straight on). Streams never touch each other except where they fork, so they stay distinct. Each Room to grow carries the river on: from the water tile nearest a random point on the newly revealed outer edge, a stream winds out to that edge, around plants, decor and features where it can and through them where it must (their soil is lost, plants and debris are gone, decor goes back to the Bag). dig: digging an empty tile next to water turns it into water (its soil is lost) for cost + step x tiles dug so far.
water._levels: The water's level each day from its power (weather + moon): the first level whose `below` the power is under. inset: how many pixels of bank show between the water and dry land (negative: it spills over the bank). cross: each night, the chance for soil on a bank to be carried across the stream.

weather._about: Each local day has weather, deterministic from the garden seed: it repeats yesterday's with `persistence`, otherwise it's drawn by `weight`. The forecast shows today and tomorrow. `power` is how hard that day's weather drives the water at night.

moon._about: The real moon's phase on each local day (synodic month from a known new moon). Its power adds to the weather's: the water runs highest when a storm meets a full moon.

tides._about: Every six hours (local 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00) the tide turns and soil spreads from every patch that touches the water: a patch is soil of one school joined side by side or corner to corner (never across water), and if any of its tiles is on a bank (touching water), every tile of it can spread. A patch with no tile on a bank (an island) stays its size. The day's power = weather power + moon power sets the water level; the spread uses power + basePower, so even a still day moves a little. Each tile of such a patch may spread to an open neighbour that isn't already its soil (chance inland x (power + basePower)), and its bank tiles also along the bank to a neighbouring bank tile (chance alongBank x (power + basePower)), both capped at cap. Soil never spreads through the water: a corner step is only allowed when neither tile beside it is water. At a High or Flood level (water.levels: cross) it may also carry across the stream to the far bank. A tile resists by its maturity, and more with a plant growing on it: it holds with chance resist / (resist + hold), where resist = maturity (0 for plain) + plantHold. Each tile that held its soil through a tide matures a level with matureChance, up to the max (about one level every 12 hours). Catch-up covers at most maxTides.

well._about: The wishing well (landmarks.json landmark.well), found by the second Room to grow. Each six-hour block (00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00 local, like the tides) it's drawn to one focus: a school, or all flora (plants) or all fungi (mushrooms), in a shuffled round so each comes up in turn. The player drops in any handful of grown or foraged items. Its worth = each item's sell price, times `desire` if it matches the focus. luck = log2(1 + worth / luckScale), at most maxLuck. The reward is one of: coins (worth × a random rate in coinRate), a blessing or a seed packet, weighted coins `weights.coins`, blessing weights.blessing + blessingPerLuck × luck, packet weights.packet + packetPerLuck × luck. A blessing lasts blessing.hours: one school (two with chance two + twoPerLuck × luck, at most twoMax) grows `mult` times as fast and can be planted on any soil, at full speed. Blessings don't stack: a school blessed twice grows at `mult` for longer. Its school is the focus, if that's a school, else drawn from the handful by worth. A packet is a blind packet of that school; its tier is drawn from packets.base (common…legendary) with tier i weighted × e^(luckPerTier × luck × i). Every reward and tier keeps a chance at any luck.
